SYNTHETIC KYC SOP — DEVELOPMENT AND DEMONSTRATION ONLY
Fictional Example Organization. Version demo-1. Not a real company policy.
Not RBI/SEBI guidance; no statement here describes an actual legal obligation.

1. A demonstration onboarding operator records the fictional customer's name.
2. The operator logs the sample identity-review decision in a demo register.
3. A demonstration reviewer checks the register and records follow-up actions.
4. Unresolved sample records are escalated to the fictional demo team lead.
5. Review cadence and retention duration are intentionally unspecified for tests.
